title: Consult an advisor without transferring task ownership
narrative: Sparse advisor counsel helps at hard boundaries while the active executor keeps ownership. Budgets stop routine consultation. Accepts inspiration requirement 18[^insp-r18].
implementation: `Advisor` / `AdvisorPolicy` in `mechaharness.advisor` are distinct from `GraphEscalation` (ownership transfer). `DefaultAdvisorPolicy` rate-limits consultations; `consult_advisor` records `AdvisorObservation` and never transfers task ownership. Default DI binds `RejectAdvisor` with an explicit continue fallback.
validation: Kind `sparse_advisor_consult`. Soft expects: first consultation returns guidance; second blocked by budget; observation recorded. Unit: `tests/test_inspiration_primitives.py`.
